summary: pi-discover ships an Obsidian companion plugin (id `pi-research`, display name "Discover", v0.6.3) built from three `.cjs` files into a committed `main.js`. It provides (a) a custom dark `ItemView` reading pane, (b) a `research-visual` code-block processor that reads a vault-relative `Visuals/<id>/spec.json` and renders it as a sandboxed inline-`srcdoc` iframe chart, and (c) a headless "presentation preflight" that renders Markdown at two widths and writes back a layout report. It also owns the `markdownIssues`/`inspectRendered`/`inspectSvg` validators shared with the Pi side (`src/presentation.mjs` and `src/tools.mjs` require these). The ONLY plugin-dependent note artifact is the ```research-visual fenced block; tables, Mermaid, callouts(none used), static `preview.svg` embeds and plain Markdown all render without it.

files.description: Source of the plugin: Plugin subclass, ResearchView (ItemView), VisualChild (MarkdownRenderChild), ConversationPicker (SuggestModal), code-block processor, presentation preflight.

Chart schema validator (validateSpec), static SVG renderer (renderPreviewSvg), and buildChartDocument that emits the fully inline CSP-locked HTML document + chartRuntime used inside the sandboxed iframe. Required by src/tools.mjs at runtime.
markdownIssues/formatRendered/inspectSvg/inspectRendered validators. Shared by the plugin and by src/presentation.mjs (Node side).
All plugin CSS, scoped under `.pi-research-view`; defines a dark Obsidian-variable override layer and Mermaid recolor rules.
Plugin identity: id `pi-research`, name `Discover`, minAppVersion 1.5.0, isDesktopOnly true.
esbuild bundle step: entry obsidian/plugin.cjs -> obsidian/main.js, CJS/browser/es2022, obsidian external, minify:false; `--check` fails on stale bundle.
installCompanion(vault): copies main.js/styles.css/manifest.json into <vault>/.obsidian/plugins/pi-research with byte-compare + atomic rename; never edits enabled-plugin lists.
saveVisual() emits the ```research-visual embed and writes Visuals/<id>/spec.json|preview.svg|index.html|manifest.json|Visual.md; requires obsidian/visual.cjs.

architecture: main.js (committed esbuild CJS bundle) is the shipped artifact; it is generated from obsidian/plugin.cjs which requires visual.cjs + presentation.cjs. The Pi extension side (src/tools.mjs, src/presentation.mjs) requires the SAME visual.cjs/presentation.cjs so validation logic is single-sourced. installCompanion (src/install.mjs) copies the three static files into the vault. Facts flow: Pi writes Conversations/<id>/{manifest.json,Conversation.md}, _Research/stream/<id>.json, _Research/{vault,active}.json and Visuals/<id>/spec.json; the plugin watches vault events and renders them in the Discover ItemView; charts render inside an sandboxed iframe from inline spec JSON.
